comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments) and same any/binary/null rules, but the constructs differ. 0 requires specific empirical evidence: statistics, data, study findings, or documented factual cases. Anecdotes, hypotheticals and logical reasoning don't count. 1 requires a particular named or clearly identified case, person, organization, event or situation, cited to support or illustrate the argument. This covers anecdotes and personal situations with no data. A specific example with no statistics or study would count for 1 but not 0. A statistic with no localized instance would count for 0 but not 1.
